bugbot_finding.finding: Register and poller race clobbers decision state: registerPendingAuthorization loads the pending store, awaits sendDecisionMessage (wide async network window), then persists a snapshot built from the stale load. A Telegram callback processed by the poller in that window is silently reverted — ISSUED/REJECTED receipt and telegram_update_id consumption erased while the provenance registry already holds the ACTIVE entry, breaking the ACTIVE-must-have-ISSUED-receipt invariant and re-opening an already-consumed human decision. Two concurrent read-modify-write cycles over the pending store with no mutual exclusion.

recommended_corrective_pass_scope: serialize pending-store mutations with a per-process async mutex (single writer lane) shared by registerPendingAuthorization, handleTelegramDecisionUpdate, reconcileApprovedPending; OR
persist the PENDING record BEFORE awaiting Telegram send, with a send-failure compensating transition to a terminal/undeliverable state; and
re-verify no other concurrent writers exist; add a regression test that interleaves a poller-handled callback during the register send window
